decision.title: Phase 5 design: schema.h, the substrate additions, the XSD suite (packet )
decision.summary: Phase 5 adds schema.h, with validation as a tree builder filter, additive facet and complex type fields in types.h, internal schema type registration, and the W3C XSD suite with proposed gate numbers.

body.p: . Plans Phase 5 () in docs/tasks/phase-5.md; completes 's deferred "registering schema-derived atomic types" and the Phase 5 notes of , , , and .

item.p: Suite (): W3C xsdtests at 7bc3365c652a322f3d762021b3879eb92dae7e30 in third_party/xsdtests (42,174 files, 54 MB), refreshed by tools/update-test-suites.sh, excluded from private snapshots and linked (tools/private-build.sh, tools/check-main.sh). Dropped, as no test reads them: the reports' HTML, CSS and images (nistMeta/*.html, 25 MB) and CVS backup copies (.#FILE.REVISION). In scope: the tests of suite.xml applicable to an XSD 1.1 processor (version tokens 1.1, XML-1.0, XML-1.0-5e, Unicode_6.0.0, CTR-all-compile, full-xpath-in-CTA, comments-and-PIs-excluded), not queried or disputed, expecting valid or invalid: 41,538 (15,330 schema tests, 26,208 instance tests; NIST 23,170, Microsoft 14,363, Sun 1,606, Saxonica 1,376, IBM 919, others 104). The other token choices move the count by at most 47. (, the driver, measures 41,518: it applies the version tokens per element where this count or-ed them.)

schema.h (new, after xslt.h's pattern): sxml_schema (quintet) compiled from sxml_schema_documents given as TEXT, NODE (a parsed document or an inline xs:schema element) or RESOLVED through the resolver; sxml_schema_find_type, _find_element_declaration, _find_attribute_declaration; sxml_schema_validator (quintet) with _as_tree_builder and _get_outcome; sxml_schema_validate_node; sxml_schema_report_sink. XSD 1.1 only (1.0 documents are read as 1.1); schema location hints in instances are not followed (Part 1, 4.3.2 allows it); an import that cannot be read is not an error by itself (4.2.6.2).

Validation is a tree builder filter, not a tree walker: the validator receives builder events (from the XML parser while parsing, from sxml_tree_builder_copy_node, from construction) and sends them, annotated, to a result builder; the null builder makes it a pure check (sxml validate builds nothing). One mechanism serves the CLI, XQuery validate, XSLT validation, fn:doc validation and fn:xsd-validator, and the validated tree is an ordinary arena tree, since the events already carry type annotation, is-id, is-idrefs and nilled (tree.h, ). Defaults and schema normalized attribute values are events too. A failed validation delivers no tree (its events are discarded).

Errors: codes are XSD constraint names in no namespace (cvc-complex-type.2.4, src-resolve; Part 1, appendix C), static errors for compilation and dynamic errors for validation; XQuery and XSLT wrap them in their own codes, as XSLT rewrites XQDY0102 to XTDE0430. A report sink receives every error (the CLI shows all of them); the null sink stops at the first.

types.h (frozen; additive, ): sxml_content_type_variety and sxml_complex_type as the new union member complex_type of sxml_type_description (xs:anyType and xs:untyped MIXED; src/types_builtin.c now says so), sxml_facet_kind, sxml_facet, sxml_facet_view and the new last field facets of the description (empty for built-in and item types; src/types.c clears it when it normalizes an item type). Reason: "everything the registry knows about one type" must include what typed values (content variety, simple content type) and casting (facets) need. Facet values are text (the registry holds no items, as for JNode key constants), canonical in the base type, QNames as EQNames so no namespace context is needed. Assertion facets are not registry facets: they are XPath, kept by the schema, evaluated by validation and, in schema-aware expressions, after the cast, so src/cast.c never starts an evaluation (). Comments: the top of the header and sxml_type_registry_find_type.

Registration is internal: sxml_type_registry_register_schema_type in src/types_internal.h (declared now, defined by 5.5), called only by schema compilation, which checks XSD's constraints first; a public function would let hosts register definitions that bypass them, and the registry would need a second copy of those checks. Schema types are never interned and are registered without entering the name index: names belong to a schema (sxml_schema_find_type), as made named item types aliases of a module, so two schemas of one processor may define one name. Registered types outlive their schema (trees keep their annotations).

tree.h, xdm.h (frozen; contract comments): a tree without get_typed_value gets typed values derived from string value and type annotation (simple types by casting with the element's namespaces, complex types by content type variety, nilled: none) in sxml_node_make_typed_value. The old text said such a tree holds only untyped nodes; for those nothing changes, so no tree that kept the contract changes behaviour. Reason: one derivation for every tree (arena and host trees alike) and nothing stored per node; the arena tree stays as it is.

processor.h (with a record, ): SXML_RESOURCE_KIND_SCHEMA_DOCUMENT at the end of the kinds (forms BYTES, DOCUMENT_NODE), using for the namespace; the QT4 driver's resolver lists it (tests/qt4/driver/resource_table.c).

Reuse, not parallel machinery: schema documents through the XML parser and an arena tree (); facets and lexical spaces through src/cast.c alone; patterns through the regex engine with an XSD dialect flag (); assertions, type alternatives and identity constraints compiled with xpath.h and evaluated by the one evaluator on subtrees the validator records; schema-element(N) and schema-attribute(N) resolved statically to choices of the existing element(M, T) and attribute(N, T) tests over the substitution group, so matching and subtyping need no schema in the type registry (static analysis then no longer sets the is_schema_declaration flag of sxml_node_test, ).

Integration (5.11, 5.12), each replacing one rejection place (, ): sxml_static_context_configuration.in_scope_schemas (a view of compiled schemas, last field, empty = not schema-aware) with a record by 5.11; XQuery import schema (XQST0009, src/xquery_static.c) and validate (XQST0075, src/xquery_lower.c); XPST0008 of schema-element in src/xpath_static.c; FODC0009 of the xsd-validation option (src/function_library_json.c); fn:xsd-validator (absent, XPST0017); xsl:import-schema (XTSE1650) and validation and type attributes (XTSE1660, src/xslt_read.c); the QT4 and XSLT drivers' feature lists.

Gate (proposed, for the owner): in-scope XSD 1.1 tests ≥ 90%, the datatype groups (NIST, MS-DataTypes, MS-Regex: 30,598) ≥ 95%, the structure groups (8,645) ≥ 80%, the XSD 1.1 groups (Saxonica, IBM: 2,295) ≥ 70%; schema-aware QT4 XQ40 cases (about 1,100) ≥ 70%; schema-aware XSLT cases (about 690) ≥ 60%; the Phase 2 to 4 gates still held and no count dropped; no crash, leak or error outcome.
sxml validate is designed in phase-5.md (synopsis, options, JSON shape, exit codes) and enters docs/CLI.md with packet (: only once it works).
